useCase: Detecting hidden information, compression irregularities, and generado por IA JPEG anomalías
mechanism: Analiza the distribución of quantized DCT coeficientes using chi-square statistics. Expected distribucións follow predictable patrones for natural images; deviations indicate manipulación, AI generation, or hidden data embedding.
accuracy: Medium - 72-83% for detecting compression anomalías and AI artefactos
name: Analisis Chi-cuadrado
parameters: Tamaño de bloque: 8x8 DCT, Test: chi-square goodness-of-fit, Significance: p < 0.05, Coefficients: AC components
description: Aplica chi-square estadístico test to DCT coeficiente distribucións para detectar steganographic embedding and compression anomalías common in AI outputs.

references.title: Westfeld, A. & Pfitzmann, A. (2000). Attacks on Steganographic Systems. Information Hiding.
Fridrich, J. et al. (2003). Detection of Double-Compression in JPEG Images. Information Hiding.

strengths:
• Well-established estadístico framework
• Detecta both steganography and AI artefactos
• Fast computation on DCT coeficientes
• Quantifiable p-value for confidence
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG compressed images
• Sensitive to image quality and size
• High compression can mask anomalías
• Limited effectiveness on PNG/WebP formats
